sniffEpisode(){var menuList=document.querySelectorAll('#y-playList .tab-item');var sourceList=document.querySelectorAll('.module-play-list .module-play-list-content');if(!sourceList||sourceList.length==0){sendSourceMap({});return}var sourceMap={};for(var i=0;i<sourceList.length;i++){var episodeList=sourceList[i].getElementsByTagName('a');if(episodeList.length==0){continue}const sourceName=menuList[i].getAttribute('data-dropdown-value');sourceMap[sourceName]=Array.from(episodeList).map((item)=>({'name':item.querySelector('span').textContent,'url':item.href}))}sendSourceMap(sourceMap)}async function sniffPlayUrl(){console.error('找到iframe');const iframe=await waitForElement('#playleft iframe',10,200);if(iframe){let src=iframe.getAttribute('src');if(src&&!src.startsWith('http')){src=window.location.origin+src}sendLoadIframe(src);return}const video=await waitForElement('video',10,200);if(!video){sniffLog('未找到video元素');sendPlayUrl('');return}const el=document.querySelector(selector);if(el){resolve(el);return}count++;if(count>=maxRetry){resolve(null);return}setTimeout(poll,intervalMs)}poll()})}async function getVerifyImageBase64(img){if(!img){return null}if(!img.complete||img.naturalWidth===0){await new canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=img.naturalWidth;canvas.height=img.naturalHeight;var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.drawImage(img,0,0);return
